sql:
WITH per_line AS (
  SELECT l.order_id,
         l.line_id,
         l.line_cents,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_status = 'posted' THEN r.refund_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS line_refund_cents
  FROM order_lines_dv_lir_00 l
  LEFT JOIN refunds_dv_lir_00 r ON r.line_id = l.line_id
  GROUP BY l.order_id, l.line_id, l.line_cents
)
SELECT o.order_id,
       o.account_id,
       COUNT(p.line_id) AS qualifying_line_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.line_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.line_refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.line_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.line_refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents
FROM orders_dv_lir_00 o
JOIN accounts_dv_lir_00 a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
JOIN per_line p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE a.region = 'east'
  AND o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.account_id
ORDER BY o.order_id;

WITH qualifying_lines AS (
  SELECT l.order_id, l.line_id, l.line_cents
  FROM order_lines_dv_lir_01 l
  JOIN orders_dv_lir_01 o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN accounts_dv_lir_01 a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  WHERE l.line_cents <> 0
    AND a.region = 'west'
    AND o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
    AND o.currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
), line_refunds AS (
  SELECT ql.line_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents
  FROM qualifying_lines ql
  LEFT JOIN refunds_dv_lir_01 r ON r.line_id = ql.line_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY ql.line_id
)
SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id,
       COUNT(ql.line_id) AS qualifying_line_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(ql.line_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(lr.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(ql.line_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents
FROM orders_dv_lir_01 o
JOIN accounts_dv_lir_01 a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
JOIN qualifying_lines ql ON ql.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN line_refunds lr ON lr.line_id = ql.line_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
  AND o.currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM line_refunds lr2
    WHERE lr2.line_id = ql.line_id AND lr2.refund_cents > 0
  )
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.account_id
ORDER BY o.order_id

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_cents,
         (SELECT f.rate_id
            FROM fx_rates_dv_fx_00 f
           WHERE f.currency = o.currency
             AND f.valid_from <= o.ordered_at
             AND o.ordered_at <= f.valid_to
           ORDER BY f.valid_from DESC, f.rate_id DESC
           LIMIT 1) AS rate_id,
         (SELECT f.usd_micros
            FROM fx_rates_dv_fx_00 f
           WHERE f.currency = o.currency
             AND f.valid_from <= o.ordered_at
             AND o.ordered_at <= f.valid_to
           ORDER BY f.valid_from DESC, f.rate_id DESC
           LIMIT 1) AS usd_micros
    FROM orders_dv_fx_00 o
   WHERE o.currency <> 'USD'
)
SELECT m.order_id,
       m.currency,
       m.amount_cents,
       m.rate_id,
       CASE
         WHEN m.rate_id IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)
         ELSE CAST(ROUND(m.amount_cents * m.usd_micros / 1000000.0, 0) AS INTEGER)
       END AS usd_cents
  FROM matched m
 ORDER BY m.order_id

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_cents,
         f.rate_id, f.usd_micros,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY o.order_id
           ORDER BY f.valid_from DESC, f.rate_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM orders_dv_fx_01 o
  LEFT JOIN fx_rates_dv_fx_01 f
    ON f.currency = o.currency
   AND o.ordered_at >= f.valid_from
   AND o.ordered_at <  f.valid_to
  WHERE o.currency <> 'USD'
    AND o.amount_cents <> 0
)
SELECT order_id, currency, amount_cents,
       rate_id,
       CASE WHEN rate_id IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(ROUND(amount_cents * usd_micros / 1000000.0, 0) AS INTEGER)
       END AS usd_cents
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY order_id

  SELECT f.rate_id, f.currency, f.usd_micros,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.currency ORDER BY f.valid_from DESC, f.rate_id DESC) AS rn

    AND o.currency <> 'USD'
)

       CAST(ROUND(o.amount_cents * rp.usd_micros / 1000000.0, 0) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents
FROM orders_dv_fx_02 o

                 AND o.ordered_at < (SELECT f2.valid_to FROM fx_rates_dv_fx_02 f2 WHERE f2.rate_id = rp.rate_id)
ORDER BY o.order_id

  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount_cents, o.ordered_at, g.segment,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY o.order_id
           ORDER BY g.valid_from DESC, g.row_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM orders_dv_scd_00 o
  JOIN customer_segments_dv_scd_00 g
    ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id
   AND g.valid_from <= o.ordered_at
   AND o.ordered_at <= g.valid_to
)
SELECT order_id, customer_id, segment, amount_cents
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY order_id

  FROM orders_dv_scd_01 o

  JOIN customer_segments_dv_scd_01 g

)
SELECT order_id, customer_id, segment, amount_cents

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount_cents, g.segment, g.valid_from, g.row_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY o.order_id
           ORDER BY g.valid_from DESC, g.row_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM orders_dv_scd_02 o
  LEFT JOIN customer_segments_dv_scd_02 g
    ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id
   AND g.valid_from <= o.ordered_at
   AND o.ordered_at < g.valid_to
)
SELECT order_id, customer_id, COALESCE(segment, 'unknown') AS segment, amount_cents
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1 OR rn IS NULL
ORDER BY order_id

WITH matching AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount_cents, o.ordered_at,
         g.segment, g.valid_from, g.row_id
  FROM orders_dv_scd_03 o
  JOIN customer_segments_dv_scd_03 g
    ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id
   AND g.valid_from <= o.ordered_at
   AND o.ordered_at <= g.valid_to
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.order_id, m.customer_id, m.amount_cents, m.segment,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY m.order_id
           ORDER BY m.valid_from DESC, m.row_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM matching m
)
SELECT o.order_id,
       o.customer_id,
       COALESCE(r.segment, 'unknown') AS segment,
       o.amount_cents
FROM orders_dv_scd_03 o
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.rn = 1
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
ORDER BY o.order_id;
